sections.h2: Why Businesses Need a Custom AI Chatbot

paragraphs.text: Visitors expect fast answers, often outside office hours. A custom AI chatbot replies instantly using your real prices, services, policies and stock, instead of generic scripts. It handles repeated questions, so your staff can focus on conversations that need a person. For many businesses, a well-trained bot resolves a large share of routine questions without any staff involvement.

AI chatbot vs rule-based chatbot: older rule-based chatbots follow fixed menus and break when customers type something unexpected. An AI chatbot understands natural questions, follows context across a conversation and can answer in the customer's own words and language. For most businesses, AI chatbots convert more visitors and frustrate fewer.

sections.intro: Our AI chatbot development services Kerala clients use cover planning, content training, design, integration, testing and ongoing improvement.

items.title: Website Chatbot Development
items.text: Website chatbot development adds a chat window to your site that greets visitors, answers questions, recommends services or products and collects contact details. It matches your brand colours and tone, works on mobile, and can be switched to a contact form outside working hours if you prefer. Conversation starters can change by page, so a visitor on your pricing page sees different suggestions from one reading a blog post. The chat widget loads separately, so it does not slow your pages.

items.title: ChatGPT Chatbot for Your Website
items.text: A ChatGPT chatbot for website use connects your chat window to a leading large language model, guided by your own content and rules. We control what it may and may not discuss, so it stays on topic, avoids guessing and never invents prices or promises.

items.title: Chatbot With Knowledge Base
items.text: A chatbot with knowledge base access searches your website pages, brochures, policies and FAQs before replying, and can show the source of each answer. This reduces wrong answers and lets customers check details for themselves. Updating the bot is as simple as updating the documents it reads.

items.title: Instagram DM Automation
items.text: Instagram DM automation replies to direct messages, story mentions and common comment questions, shares product links and collects enquiry details. It suits brands that receive many repeated questions about price, availability and delivery. Replies follow Meta's messaging rules, and your team can take over any conversation from the Instagram inbox.

items.title: Customer Support Chatbot
items.text: A customer support chatbot answers order, delivery, returns and service questions, checks order status where connected, and creates support tickets for anything it cannot solve. Each ticket includes the full conversation, so customers never have to repeat themselves.

items.title: Lead Generation Chatbot
items.text: A lead generation chatbot asks short qualifying questions, such as budget, location and timeline, then sends hot leads to your sales team by email or CRM within seconds. Each lead arrives with a short summary of the conversation, so your team can respond with context.

items.title: Malayalam and Arabic AI Chatbots
items.text: A Malayalam AI chatbot lets Kerala customers ask questions in their own language, including mixed Malayalam and English. An Arabic AI chatbot serves Gulf customers with right-to-left chat layouts and natural Arabic replies. We test answer quality in every language before launch, using real questions from your past enquiries where available.

items.title: AI Chatbot for Ecommerce
items.text: An AI chatbot for ecommerce helps shoppers find products, compare options, check sizes and delivery times, and recover abandoned carts with helpful reminders. It can also suggest related products based on what the shopper is looking at.

items.title: AI Chatbot for Colleges
items.text: An AI chatbot for colleges and training institutes answers questions about courses, fees, eligibility, admission dates and hostel facilities, and collects enquiry details for the admissions team. During admission season, it can handle hundreds of similar questions a day without extra staff.

paragraphs.text: Other common projects include chatbots for travel agencies, property developers, clinics, hotels and local service companies across Kerala.

paragraphs.html: No chatbot should trap customers. Our chatbot handoff to live agent feature passes the conversation, with its full history, to a team member by chat, email or WhatsApp when the customer asks for a person or the question needs human judgement.

paragraphs.text: Is an AI chatbot accurate? It is as accurate as the content and rules behind it. We train each bot on approved information, instruct it to say when it does not know, test it against real customer questions and review conversations after launch. Chatbot analytics and training show which questions are asked most, where answers fall short and which content needs updating.

Customer conversations often include names, phone numbers and order details. We store chat logs securely, limit who on your team can view them, and send AI models only the information needed to answer each question. We use AI providers whose business terms state that API data is not used to train their models by default, and we can mask personal details in logs where required.
The bot also follows clear limits: it will not share internal information, make payments or confirm discounts unless you allow it.

Every chatbot project includes the configured bot, the chat window design, connected channels, an admin login for conversation history, a short guide for updating content, and a monthly report on questions, leads and handoffs during the support period.

sections.h2: What Is Our Chatbot Process and Timeline?
sections.intro: How long does it take to build a chatbot? Most projects follow these stages:

items.title: Discovery (2 to 3 days)
items.text: We agree on goals, channels, languages and handoff rules.

items.title: Content preparation (3 to 7 days)
items.text: We gather and organise the information the bot will use.

items.title: Build and integration (1 to 3 weeks)
items.text: We set up the bot, design the chat window and connect your tools.

items.title: Testing (3 to 5 days)
items.text: We test with real questions in every language.

items.title: Launch and training (ongoing)
items.text: We review conversations and improve answers monthly.

paragraphs.text: Typical totals: 2 to 3 weeks for a website chatbot, and 4 to 6 weeks for a multilingual bot with Instagram and CRM connections.

sections.h2: How Much Does an AI Chatbot Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: How much does an AI chatbot cost in India? It depends on channels, languages, the amount of content, integrations and expected message volume. Costs include a one-time setup and a monthly running cost for AI usage, which grows with the number of conversations. Every project is quoted after discovery, with a fixed setup price and a monthly estimate.

items.q: Can the chatbot connect to our CRM or booking system?
items.a: Yes. We connect chatbots to common CRMs, booking tools, spreadsheets and email so leads, appointments and tickets are created automatically, without staff copying details.

items.q: Will the chatbot work on mobile?
items.a: Yes. The chat window is designed for mobile first, because most visitors arrive on phones. It loads quickly and does not cover important parts of your page.

items.q: Can we change what the chatbot says?
items.a: Yes. You can update the content it learns from at any time, and we adjust tone, greetings and rules on request. Most changes take effect immediately.
The chatbot keeps answering questions and collecting enquiries 24 hours a day. Requests that need a person are queued and sent to your team for the next working morning.
